name: Martin's Sweet Shop
lead: More than 30 flavors of hand-dipped Blue Bell, Italian ices and candy on Washington Avenue. Rated 4.9 stars by 110 Google reviewers.
about: Martin Price started selling ice cream from a cart in Brooklyn when he was 14. More than 50 years later he runs his own corner shop in downtown Navasota.
Texas Highways sends visitors here for the creamsicle soda float or Blue Bell scoops in a cone. Locals come back for the triple chocolate, sundaes and ice cream sandwiches.
